description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止请求重复提交。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests.
The ID of the instance for which you want to modify the configurations.

description.zh:
变配类型，取值
- Upgrade：升级。
- Downgrade：降级。
description.en:
The type of configuration modifications. Valid values:

*   Upgrade: upgrades the configurations of the instance.
*   Downgrade: downgrades the configurations of the instance.
The code of the service to which the instance belongs.
The type of the service to which the instance belongs.

description.zh:
付费类型，取值：
- Subscription：预付费。
- PayAsYouGo：后付费。
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:

*   Subscription: subscription
*   PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
